svg.title: Tortie Moon Conservatory — fillable paint-by-number page
svg.desc: A curled, sleeping tortoiseshell cat with clear ears, muzzle, closed eyes, coat patches, haunches, and a tail wrapped around its body. Full-color library preview; opening the SVG changes paintable regions into a numbered worksheet.
